support_route.instructions: Which team should handle this customer support message

criteria.billing: Charges, refunds, invoices, subscriptions, payment failures
criteria.technical: Bugs, errors, crashes, login or integration problems
criteria.account: Profile changes, password reset, deleting or transferring an account
criteria.shipping: Delivery status, delays, lost or damaged packages, returns
criteria.sales: Pricing questions, plans, demos, buying more seats

urgency.instructions: How urgently a human needs to respond to this message
criteria: Needs a response within the hour
Immediate: safety risk or critical outage

sentiment.instructions: What is the writer's overall sentiment

toxic.instructions: The text contains insults, slurs, harassment or threats aimed at a person

spam.instructions: The text is unsolicited promotion, a scam or a phishing attempt

intent.instructions: What does the user want the assistant to do

criteria.question: Answer a factual or how-to question
criteria.task: Perform an action such as booking, sending or creating something
criteria.complaint: Register a complaint or report a problem
criteria.chitchat: Casual conversation with no real request
